  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  May 09, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on May 09, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on April 25, 2024
Approval of the Minutes of the Special Meeeting held on May 6, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Rena Troldahl on behalf of United Way of Greater Los Angeles to host a WalkUnitedLA
  Event at 1001 Stadium Dr.,Sofi Stadium, Private Property,on Saturday, May 11, 2024, from
  6:30 a.m. – 1:30 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to recommendations outlined by the Planning
  Department / Inglewood Police Department; Approval for 1 day event within SOFI stadium
  parking lot. Approval with conditions for special event: Applicant(s) and responsible
  person(s) shall allow access to Code Enforcement personnel upon request, and shall
  comply with Code Enforcement requirements for any code violations identified. Applicant(s)
  and responsible person(s) shall mitigate noise levels from amplified sound per IMC Ch.5
  Article 2 - Noise Regulations. All vendors and Food Trucks shall obtain business licenses
  and/or business tax certificates prior to the day of the special event. All parties subject to
  all applicable Federal, State, and Local Laws including Inglewood Municipal Code
  regulations. Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the
  end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
 Permits & License Committee  May 09, 2024
Minutes  Page 2 of 5

  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384443)

Item #2:  Anthony Harris on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Splish – Splash – Water Safety
  Event at 700 Warren Lane,Edward Vincent Jr. Park – Swim Complex, Public Property, on
  Saturday, May 18 ,2024, from 11:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at Edward
  Vincent Park; IPD will staff two (2) IPD officers for public safety; Watch Commander will be
  notified and extra patrol / high visibility will be provided as time permits; Maintain site at all
  times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384467)

Item #3:  Sidney Jackson on behalf of Phi Beta Sigma/Frat Games to host a Community Softball
  Event at 3400 W Arbor Vitae St., Darby Park – Baseball Field #2, Public Property, every
  Sunday of each month, from Sunday, June 16, 2024- September 1st, 2024 1:45 p.m. -5:15
  p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Approval for a multi Sunday event at Darby Park.; Applicant to hire a minimum of 4
  professional licensed security guards or off-duty police officers ("Frat Brothers") for the
  safety of attendees.; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately
  at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all
  social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set
  forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all
  State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384381)

Item #4:  Lionel Pasamonte on behalf of Community Economic Development to host a 1983
  Flashback Fundraiser Event at 8729 Aviation Blvd., Volume Studios, Private Property, on
  Saturday, June 22,,2024 from 2:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event within
  Volume Studios Parking Lot; Approved Conditionally; Applicant to hire one (1 ) Sgt, two
  (2 ) police officers for public safety and a minimum of eight (8) professional-licensed
  security guards to assist IPD with any potential crowd control. There shall be 2 security
  guards assigned to work the alcohol beverage garden to ensure there is NO underage
  alcohol possession or consumption.Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
 Permits & License Committee  May 09, 2024
Minutes  Page 3 of 5

  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384378)

Item #5:  Noelle Lai on behalf of UCLA Blood Platelet Center to host a Blood Drive Event at One W.
  Manchester Blvd., Inglewood City Hall Community Room A, Public Property , on Monday,
  July 22, 2024, from 9:00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO
  THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONSApproval for 1 day event at City Hall Community Room
  A; ;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384362)
Item #6:  Isai Pazos on behalf of Regional Organization of Oaxaca to host a XXXVII Festival
  Gueaguetza ORO 2024 Event at 700 Warren Lane, Edward Vincent Jr. Park – outdoor
  Amphitheater, Public Property, on Sunday, August 11, 2024, from 11:00a.m. – 8:00 p.m.
  Approved; Applicant to hire one (1 ) Sergeant and three (3) police officers for public safety
  and four (4) TCO's for traffic safety / control during this event; Applicant to also hire
  adequate security staff to assist IPD with potential crowd control and monitor the restrooms
  being used by guests to prevent any outside lewd activity; IPD WC will be notified and extra
  patrol requested as time permits.Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00383757)
New Business License Renewal Request (s):
Item #7:  Alexander Lando DBA LA City Fisker to operate as an Auto Cars (used) at 817 N La Brea
  Ave. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license fee and taxes; An expired or lapsed license for more
  than six months will negatively impact your license renewal; Parking, repairs and/or
  maintenance on city streets, sidewalks, or alleys of any vehicles for sale is strictly prohibited
  and violators will be cited and towed at owners expense;Applicant and all employees must
  have a valid ID and DMV / Dealer licenses if applicable;Subject to inspection by any Code
  Enforcement Officer or Police Officer; Approval for new and used auto sales. Must comply
  with all conditions of SP-1225. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. Adhere to all
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations (including noise and
  signage) Local, State and Federal Laws.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00384500)

Item #8:  Nikko Thompson DBA Total Look Logistics to operate as an Auto Cars (used) at 122 S.
  Market  St. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees; An expired or lapsed
  license for more than six months will negatively impact your business license renewal;
  Provide copy of Department of Motor Vehicles, Dealer License-Wholesale Only to the
  Finance Department;Strictly restricted to office use only;Automobiles are not permitted to
  be displayed for sale, parked or repaired on City streets, sidewalks and/or alleys;Subject
  to inspection by any Code Enforcement Officer or Police Officer;Adhere to all State,
  Federal, County and applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage
  Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your
  business license and any future business license application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384293)

Item #9:  Michael Young DBA Six Seven Five Lounge to operate as a Restaurant – Live
  Entertainment at 675 S. La Brea Ave. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Obtain
  annual approval from the Permits and License Committee for events and live entertainment
  at the site;ALL patrons / employees shall have valid identification to be inside and remain
  as an employee or paying customer at the location (Bar area only). Valid ID shall be
  available upon request to any law enforcement or code enforcement officer(s);Applicant
  shall post NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS in front / outside of the business as
  well;The applicant or his / her designee are subject to random permit & license /
  establishment inspections at ANYTIME of the day or night, by any police or code
  enforcement officer(s), including California Department of Alcohol Beverage Control
  Investigators. The purpose of random inspections are to ensure that the listed
  establishment are adhering to the regulations set forth by the State of California Alcohol
  Beverage Control, City of Inglewood / Permits & Licensing committee; Facility use 4 pm
  -2 am DailyEvents with live entertainment shall be from 8:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m. The
  number of events ending after midnight shall be limited to three events per month;Adhere
  to SP -1128 in its entirety; and Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any
  future business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00384457)
